candidates.name: BigCommerce
candidates.description: Both platforms provide comprehensive SaaS-based ecommerce infrastructure for businesses to build, manage, and scale their online stores.
candidates.rationale: Direct ecommerce platform competitor serving merchants with similar SaaS commerce infrastructure and buyer base.

candidates.name: Shift4Shop, LLC
candidates.description: Both companies offer end-to-end ecommerce software solutions designed to help merchants launch and manage online retail operations.
candidates.rationale: Direct ecommerce platform competitor serving merchants with similar store, payments, and operations software.

candidates.name: SHOPLINE Limited
candidates.description: Both provide an integrated commerce platform that enables merchants to sell through omnichannel solutions, including web and social commerce.
candidates.rationale: Direct commerce-platform competitor to Shopify with similar merchant customers and omnichannel selling tools.

candidates.name: Ecwid, Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer shopping cart software that allows merchants to easily add an online store to their existing websites or social media channels.
candidates.rationale: Direct e-commerce platform competitor serving merchants with similar online store and checkout software.

candidates.name: Volusion, LLC
candidates.description: Both companies provide dedicated ecommerce website building tools and hosting services specifically for online selling.
candidates.rationale: Direct ecommerce platform competitor to Shopify, serving merchants with store-building, hosting, and online sales tools.

candidates.name: Fynd
candidates.description: Both platforms offer commerce-focused SaaS tools that enable businesses to build websites, modernize retail, and automate operations.
candidates.rationale: Commerce SaaS platform for merchants, similar to Shopify’s online store, retail, and operations software.

candidates.name: VTEX Partnership
candidates.description: Both provide unified, enterprise-grade commerce suites designed to help businesses manage complex online selling operations.
candidates.rationale: VTEX is a direct commerce platform competitor to Shopify, serving similar merchants with overlapping ecommerce and operations needs.

candidates.name: Cart.com
candidates.description: Both offer unified commerce solutions that integrate the software and infrastructure required for brands to manage online sales and logistics.
candidates.rationale: Directly comparable commerce platform offering unified commerce software and logistics for brands, overlapping buyer persona and use case.

candidates.name: Squarespace
candidates.description: Both provide website building platforms that include robust native ecommerce functionality for small to medium-sized businesses.
candidates.rationale: Both are commerce/website platforms selling to SMB merchants with overlapping ecommerce and storefront use cases.

candidates.name: Wix.Com Ltd
candidates.description: Both offer versatile website builders that feature deep integrations for online stores and business management tools.
candidates.rationale: Same SMB commerce/website platform category with overlapping merchant customers and ecommerce tools.

candidates.name: Lightspeed Restaurant
candidates.description: Both platforms bridge the gap between physical retail POS systems and online commerce, offering a suite of tools for omnichannel management.
candidates.rationale: Different category: restaurant POS software, not a commerce platform like Shopify.

candidates.name: Gorgias Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide specialized software applications that integrate directly into the ecommerce technology stack to facilitate business growth.
candidates.rationale: Gorgias is an ecommerce support/helpdesk app, not a commerce platform like Shopify; adjacent tool, not same business model.

candidates.name: OpenCart Limited
candidates.description: Both provide foundational shopping cart technology that allows merchants to build and customize their online retail stores.
candidates.rationale: Both are commerce platforms for merchants to build and operate online stores, serving the same buyer and use case.
